import os,sys,json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import replace
from types import SimpleNamespace
import numpy as np
import psutil
from scipy.stats import skew,kurtosis,ks_2samp
psutil.cpu_count=lambda logical=True:int(os.environ.get('SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK','8'))
from workloads.morrison import make_morrison,inspect_state
from workloads.provenance import manifest,write_json,command
from ports.genn_port import GeNNBrunel
from ports.common import DT_MS
delay=float(os.environ['MORRISON_CASE_DELAY'])
out=Path('../settling_morrison_'+str(delay).replace('.','p')+'_'+os.environ['SLURM_JOB_ID'])
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
(out/'command.txt').write_text(sys.argv[1])
gpu=command(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'])
assert gpu['returncode']==0 and any(('H800' in x or 'A800' in x) and int(x.split(',')[1])>=75000 for x in gpu['stdout'].splitlines())
spec=replace(make_morrison(),delay_ms=delay)
args=SimpleNamespace(output=out,seed=20260724,delay_ms=delay,max_sim_seconds=500,sample_seconds=10,chunk_seconds=1)
rules={'minimum_seconds':200,'window_seconds':100,'check_interval_seconds':50,'consecutive_passes':2,'max_abs_std_linear_drift_fraction_per_window':.01,'max_std_range_fraction':.02,'max_abs_mean_linear_drift_pa_per_window':.10,'max_window_endpoint_ks_distance':.02}
md=spec.as_dict();md.update(family='morrison-settling-diagnostic',effective_delivery_ms=delay+DT_MS,stdp_timing='nest_dendritic' if delay else 'arrival',post_path_delay_ms=2*delay)
write_json(out/'manifest.json',manifest(args)|{'model':md,'gpu':gpu,'settling_rules':rules,'protocol':'fresh full-size run; fixed 100000-edge sample every 10 seconds, raw samples and histogram retained; stop after two passing 100-second windows checked 50 seconds apart or at 500 seconds; no retuning','stopping_rules':{'population_rate_hz':100,'nonfinite_state':'abort','sampled_weight_max_pa':1000}})
start=time.perf_counter()
net=None;rows=[];samples=[];checks=[];passes=0;status='running';error=None
try:
 net=GeNNBrunel(spec=spec,seed=args.seed,state_seed=args.seed,backend='cuda',build_path=out/'build',recording_steps=0,precision='float',stdp_timing='nest_dendritic' if delay else 'arrival',stdp_tie_order='nest_causal_boundary',timing_enabled=False,record_spikes=False,collect_connectivity_stats=False)
 build_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start
 deg={}
 for name,syn in [('ee',net.ee),('ei',net.ei),('ie',net.ie),('ii',net.ii)]:
  syn._row_lengths.pull_from_device();deg[name]=np.asarray(syn._row_lengths.view,dtype=np.uint64).copy()
 net._outdegrees=deg
 lengths=deg['ee'].astype(np.int64);cumulative=np.cumsum(lengths)
 assert int(cumulative[-1])==810000000
 logical=np.linspace(0,int(cumulative[-1])-1,100000,dtype=np.int64)
 sample_rows=np.searchsorted(cumulative,logical,side='right');sample_offsets=logical-np.r_[0,cumulative][sample_rows]
 np.savez_compressed(out/'sample_identity.npz',logical_edge=logical,rows=sample_rows,offsets=sample_offsets,**deg)
 def sample(end_seconds):
  v=net.ee.vars['g'];v.pull_from_device()
  values=np.asarray(v._view).reshape(spec.ne,-1)[sample_rows,sample_offsets].copy()
  assert np.all(np.isfinite(values)) and values.min()>=0 and values.max()<=1000
  counts,edges=np.histogram(values,bins=np.linspace(0,100,401))
  np.savez_compressed(out/('weights_%04d.npz'%end_seconds),weights=values,hist_counts=counts,hist_edges_pa=edges)
  row={'seconds':end_seconds,'count':len(values),'mean_pa':float(values.mean(dtype=np.float64)),'std_pa':float(values.std(dtype=np.float64)),'min_pa':float(values.min()),'max_pa':float(values.max()),'quantile_probabilities':[.01,.05,.25,.5,.75,.95,.99],'quantiles_pa':np.quantile(values,[.01,.05,.25,.5,.75,.95,.99]).tolist(),'zero_fraction':float(np.mean(values==0)),'skewness':float(skew(values.astype(float))) if end_seconds else None,'excess_kurtosis':float(kurtosis(values.astype(float))) if end_seconds else None,'hist_overflow':int(np.sum(values>=100))}
  samples.append(row)
  with (out/'weight_statistics.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({'weight_sample':row}),flush=True)
  return values
 sample(0)
 baseline=net.population_spike_counts();previous=baseline
 for sec in range(1,args.max_sim_seconds+1):
  wall=net.step(10000)
  cur=net.population_spike_counts()
  e=cur[0]-previous[0];i=cur[1]-previous[1]
  row={'seconds':sec,'wall_seconds':wall,'e_spikes':int(e.sum()),'i_spikes':int(i.sum()),'e_hz':float(e.mean()),'i_hz':float(i.mean())}
  if sec%10==0:row['state']=inspect_state(net,spec)
  rows.append(row);previous=cur
  with (out/'activity.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
  if max(row['e_hz'],row['i_hz'])>=100:raise RuntimeError('population rate guard')
  if sec%10==0:
   values=sample(sec)
   print(json.dumps({'progress_seconds':sec,'e_hz':row['e_hz'],'i_hz':row['i_hz'],'total_wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start}),flush=True)
  if sec>=200 and sec%50==0:
   tail=[s for s in samples if s['seconds']>=sec-100]
   t=np.array([s['seconds'] for s in tail]);st=np.array([s['std_pa'] for s in tail]);mu=np.array([s['mean_pa'] for s in tail])
   initial=np.load(out/('weights_%04d.npz'%(sec-100)))['weights']
   check={'end_seconds':sec,'start_seconds':sec-100,'std_start_pa':float(st[0]),'std_end_pa':float(st[-1]),'std_linear_drift_fraction':float(np.polyfit(t,st,1)[0]*100/st.mean()),'std_range_fraction':float(np.ptp(st)/st.mean()),'mean_linear_drift_pa':float(np.polyfit(t,mu,1)[0]*100),'endpoint_ks_distance':float(ks_2samp(initial,values,method='asymp').statistic)}
   check['passed']=bool(abs(check['std_linear_drift_fraction'])<.01 and check['std_range_fraction']<.02 and abs(check['mean_linear_drift_pa'])<.10 and check['endpoint_ks_distance']<.02)
   passes=passes+1 if check['passed'] else 0;check['consecutive_passes']=passes
   checks.append(check)
   with (out/'settling_checks.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(check)+'\n')
   print(json.dumps({'settling_check':check}),flush=True)
   if passes>=2:
    status='settled_by_predeclared_test'
    break
 else:status='maximum_duration_reached'
 final=net.population_spike_counts()
 np.savez_compressed(out/'final_population_counts.npz',e=final[0],i=final[1])
 counters=net.event_counters(baseline,final)
except Exception as exc:
 status='failed';error=repr(exc);raise
finally:
 write_json(out/'result.json',{'status':status,'error':error,'build_seconds':locals().get('build_seconds'),'simulated_seconds':len(rows),'simulation_wall_seconds':sum(r['wall_seconds'] for r in rows),'process_wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'weight_statistics':samples,'settling_checks':checks,'population_chunks':rows,'event_counters_enqueued':locals().get('counters')})
 if net is not None:net.close()
